newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Four killed in attempted Manila pawnshop robbery.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in attempted Manila pawnshop robbery.

text.p: Frustrated robbers shot dead four people and injured 10 when an attempt to hold up a small pawnshop in Manila went wrong, police said.

Police investigator Crispin Sarmiento said the robbers killed the owner of the pawnshop, who had failed to open the shop's vault due to a time-delay lock system, and a woman employee who was phoning the police.
Sarmiento said the 10 robbers then fired at bystanders on their way out, killing a policeman and a driver of a van travelling along the busy street.
Ten other bystanders were caught in the crossfire, he added.
The robbers also fired a grenade launcher, but the weapon misfired.
One of the suspects was later arrested.
